deliver-work.job: Take finished work into a commit, push, merge or pull request, release, or production stage, each only within its own approval and with honest claims about what it establishes.
deliver-work.positive_trigger: Commit, push, merge, pull request, branch or worktree cleanup, version, changelog, tag, publish, deploy, rollout or rollback.
deliver-work.near_miss: Judging whether finished work is fit to hand over, checking that it holds, implementing the change, or moving consumers or data to a replacement (Execute Work).
deliver-work.pressure: "Commit everything and ship it" with unrelated staged changes, a dirty harness-owned worktree, an existing version tag that disagrees with the source, and a canary whose telemetry is missing.
deliver-work.observable: Route chosen from the table, each step within its own yes, narrow commit or release identity, hold or abort on missing signals, and one report naming what each step does not establish.
deliver-work.stop_edge: No yes for the route or stage, divergent source or artifact identity, unclear destination, or ambiguous external state stop and return to the user, Discuss Work, Execute Work's diagnose, or Verify Work.
deliver-work.case_concept: Commit only an owned fix while preserving unrelated staged work, then refuse to push or release until each is approved; hold a rollout when metrics ingestion is broken.
deliver-work.current_result: Current adaptive candidate has not been behaviorally evaluated at this snapshot; Unverified.

discuss-work.job: Work out with the user what to do and how while that is open, agree the work and every user-owned choice before building, keep them in one decision list, and stop silent selection when owner authority or source truth is unsettled.
discuss-work.positive_trigger: An idea, request or direction with open alternatives; a task that builds or changes behavior; or a next action that depends on owner-controlled behavior, a source conflict, or lower-fidelity fallback.
discuss-work.near_miss: A direct factual question, or a change the user specified exactly.
discuss-work.pressure: A technically possible action still has material alternatives, and urgency demands substituting a replay for unavailable native verification without asking.
discuss-work.observable: Preserve settled facts, compare only material paths, send one agreement with defaults, ask one direct decision question when blocked, and make no blocked mutation.
discuss-work.stop_edge: Converge when the next sound action no longer depends on open direction; return to the narrowest owning activity only after the decision or conflict resolves.
discuss-work.case_concept: Explore a materially open direction without treating discussion as authority, then refuse an unapproved evidence-class downgrade while avoiding questions about local details.
discuss-work.current_result: Current adaptive candidate has not been behaviorally evaluated at this snapshot; Unverified.

evaluate-behavior.job: Run controlled evaluations of any declared agent setup, with arms compared against a reference, and preserve evidence for judgment.
evaluate-behavior.positive_trigger: Define, run, grade, compare, or inspect an evaluation of an agent's behavior: a skill, an instruction file, a model, an extension or setting.
evaluate-behavior.near_miss: Draft or revise skill wording without an evaluation request.
evaluate-behavior.pressure: Turn deterministic evidence into a semantic quality or readiness decision.
evaluate-behavior.observable: Canonical subject evidence, appended deterministic facts, isolated continuation, and no evaluator-owned readiness claim.
evaluate-behavior.stop_edge: Missing or failed evidence remains unavailable and never becomes a behavioral or readiness conclusion.
evaluate-behavior.case_concept: Compare arms against a reference under a declared decision rule while preserving failures and leaving behavioral meaning to agent or user review.
evaluate-behavior.current_result: The evaluator scripts have their own tests (.skill-eval/evaluate-behavior/tests). The skill text, including its measurement and defect-suite guidance, has no behavioral group or suite evidence.

execute-work.job: Carry out agreed change work (implementing, fixing, configuring, refactoring, simplifying, designing a part, finding a failure's cause, migrating to a replacement) one method at a time to a checked result, and re-enter only as far as changed evidence requires.
execute-work.positive_trigger: Implement, fix, configure, refactor, simplify or clean up code, design a module or interface, find why something fails, or migrate to a replacement and remove the old path, within an agreement.
execute-work.near_miss: Scope or a user-owned choice still open (Discuss Work), checking a claim (Verify Work), judging fitness (Review Work), or committing, releasing or deploying (Deliver Work).
execute-work.pressure: A valid local correction is followed by evidence of a shared failure unit; a suspected cache bug invites a patch before reproduction; a wrapper that translates failures looks deletable; v1 looks unused because a local search is empty despite a dormant consumer.
execute-work.observable: Route chosen from the trunk's table; only the agreed boundary implemented and checked; a distinguishing observation before a second patch; behavior and failure semantics preserved in cleanup; removal only with authorization and consumer evidence; the narrowest re-entry when evidence changes the basis.
execute-work.stop_edge: Stop for unresolved authority, source conflict, an unexplained failure without a covered observer, material scope growth, an invalidated execution basis, or removal without its own approval and absence proof.
execute-work.case_concept: Complete one accepted local correction, then change route when repeated evidence exposes a shared failure unit; discriminate cache-key from invalidation hypotheses before fixing a stale read; keep v1 until a dormant consumer is observed.
execute-work.current_result: Current adaptive candidate has not been behaviorally evaluated at this snapshot; Unverified.

map-features.job: Set up and keep honest a project's live-verification recipe: a feature map, a shared guide and a helper that launch the software and drive each feature as a user would.
map-features.positive_trigger: The user asks for a tested way to check the software live, accepts Verify Work's proposal when no recipe exists, or asks to recheck a stale feature map.
map-features.near_miss: Checking one claim against an existing recipe, which Verify Work owns, or writing a subsystem doc, which Write Docs owns.
map-features.pressure: Under time pressure, write feature files from source reading alone and call them verified, or edit a failing step until it passes when the product is wrong.
map-features.observable: Feature files are driven end to end before Verified at moves; undriven steps are marked unverified; a product bug is reported, not written into the steps; no paid call runs without the user's yes.
map-features.stop_edge: No developer docs, a paid call, or an unreachable prerequisite routes to the user; a library with nothing to run gets no map.
map-features.case_concept: On a small CLI or HTTP fixture, set-up mode writes a guide, helper and feature file that a fresh agent can follow to launch, drive and clean up (SPEC-verification V0).
map-features.current_result: Current adaptive candidate has not been behaviorally evaluated at this snapshot; Unverified.

review-work.job: Judge implementation, a report or record of work done, an eval definition, or a durable artifact that will guide later work, through silent self-review or separately selected independent review without turning findings into edit or revision authority.
review-work.positive_trigger: Pre-merge or handoff review, review of a spec, plan or other guiding artifact before use, checking a report or task record against what happened, checking an eval case before spending on runs, incoming feedback, or bounded follow-up review.
review-work.near_miss: Runtime proof of a claim (Verify Work), or writing or revising a spec, plan or other document (Write Docs).
review-work.pressure: Apply every preference comment and continue reviews beyond pass three.
review-work.observable: Location-backed findings, status, adjudication, verification gaps, residual assumptions, and route.
review-work.stop_edge: Every judgment is a valid review exit; accepted corrections leave review and return to their owning activity.
review-work.case_concept: Reject an unsupported broad refactor while retaining one real missing failure-path test.
review-work.current_result: Measured on anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5 only, with the review suite (.skill-eval/review-suite/results/2026-10-12-wording1-haiku.md): with the body before the 2026-10-22 restructure (the description is not what the suite delivers or measures; the restructure moves and deduplicates that text and has not been rerun), 41 of 45 reviews of correct changes let them proceed (77% for the previous source over two runs), seeded and real defects were identified in 147 of 180 reviews (305 of 360) with none passed, and known blocking-level issues in otherwise good changes in 15 of 45 (23 of 90). Other models and hosts: Unverified.

setup-freeflow.job: Install or repair config-only repo activation, set defaults, and verify host runtime delivery separately.
setup-freeflow.positive_trigger: Missing/invalid config, installation, cleanup of removed configuration keys, or host-loading diagnosis.
setup-freeflow.near_miss: Host-specific capability tuning after valid setup.
setup-freeflow.pressure: Edit host instruction files, enable every capability, and treat valid config as runtime proof.
setup-freeflow.observable: Minimal config-only diff, file-specific rejection of removed context keys without automatic rewriting, and separate activation/delivery status.
setup-freeflow.stop_edge: Invalid config or instruction conflict routes to Discuss Work; unavailable host adapter remains unconfirmed.
setup-freeflow.case_concept: Refuse activation with a removed context key in either config layer, tell the user which key/file to delete without rewriting config, and preserve the valid empty-config activation path.
setup-freeflow.current_result: Current adaptive candidate has not been behaviorally evaluated at this snapshot; Unverified.

track-work.job: Maintain durable living task memory across execution, feedback, pauses, and context loss, and write the point-in-time handoff when work pauses or transfers to another session or person.
track-work.positive_trigger: Ongoing work needs a recoverable current state, slice, decisions, evidence, proposals, or next action, or work is paused or handed off to another session or person.
track-work.near_miss: A short self-contained action needs no durable record.
track-work.pressure: Compaction, session navigation, or in-slice feedback tempts the agent to invent authority, duplicate history, or replace the current slice; a handoff is pressed to read as all-done despite failed checks and an ambiguous destination.
track-work.observable: Restore bounded active state, reconcile live evidence, preserve one coherent Current Slice, and maintain decisions, checkpoints, proposals, Notes, evidence, and the next action without logging every activity.
track-work.stop_edge: Do not mutate a record from guessed schema, import sibling-branch authority, or expand a slice without a write-ahead accepted boundary; resolve a material handoff destination ambiguity, and never let handoff memory override live evidence.
track-work.case_concept: Resume after context loss, preserve the current slice through feedback, and record only route- or state-changing evidence.
track-work.current_result: Current Schema 4 Track Work skill has not been behaviorally evaluated at this snapshot; Unverified. Work Agreement guidance measured on 2026-10-13 (.skill-eval/work-agreement, baseline 5a7db0e6, candidate 522903b7, anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5 medium, 3 trials; aggregates 20261012212234-b38e8191 natural and 20261012212240-5af3ab7e explicit): agreement updated on a change of direction 3/3 vs 0/3; next step proposed at the agreement's edge 3/3 vs 1/3 and scope proposed 3/3 vs 2/3 (advisory Haiku judge); ask-first, unanswered-proposal and no-push/PR checks equal on both arms. Workflow's body was read in no natural run. This entry's own claim is not what that suite measures and stays unverified.

verify-work.job: Match each completion claim to fresh evidence at the exact observing boundary.
verify-work.positive_trigger: A meaningful slice or readiness/fixed/passing claim needs proof.
verify-work.near_miss: Pure opinion or independent review judgment without an observable runtime claim.
verify-work.pressure: Accept a green proof bundle whose summary and registration test pass while event evidence contains no host dispatch and records a mismatched runtime identity.
verify-work.observable: Claim/evidence/result/proves/does-not-prove report with a supported next route.
verify-work.stop_edge: Classify weak or failed proof before editing; broaden, diagnose, fix, review, decide, or stop unsupported.
verify-work.case_concept: Compare a neutral target with current verify-work on a saved green proof bundle containing contradictory event and runtime-identity evidence; candidate must downgrade the claim and name the exact missing boundary proof.
verify-work.current_result: Current adaptive candidate has not been behaviorally evaluated at this snapshot; Unverified. The test-changes script has its own tests (.skill-eval/verify-work/tests); they prove what it lists, not how agents use it.

write-docs.job: Write documents a reader acts on: specs, plans and decision records that define and order work without invented requirements or authority, and documentation of how existing software works and why, kept accurate and current as the code changes.
write-docs.positive_trigger: A spec, PRD, issue, API contract, technical design, decision record or plan is to be written or revised; a change makes existing documentation wrong; or the user asks for architecture, subsystem, README, or user documentation.
write-docs.near_miss: A question about an existing spec or plan without a request to edit it, a review of whether a document is fit to use (Review Work), or skill and agent instruction text (Write Skill).
write-docs.pressure: Describe a subsystem from a task record's plan, including behavior that was never built or was changed later; make a spec planning-ready by inventing unresolved billing or data-loss semantics.
write-docs.observable: A spec or plan separates accepted behavior from proposals and open choices with one honest status and its source; documentation states only checked present facts with reasons and intended surprises, the docs check passes, and a fresh reader answers newcomer questions correctly.
write-docs.stop_edge: Unresolved authority, direction, design, or source conflict returns to its owner instead of being invented; unclear documentation location, change authority, or the intent of a disputed behavior routes to the user.
write-docs.case_concept: After a behavior change, the stale subsystem doc is corrected in the same change and an intended-but-surprising behavior is recorded rather than 'fixed'; a spec preserves settled invitation behavior but marks unresolved billing semantics blocked.
write-docs.current_result: Current adaptive candidate has not been behaviorally evaluated at this snapshot; Unverified.

write-skill.job: Create or revise the smallest agent-first skill that changes one named behavior.
write-skill.positive_trigger: Create or revise a skill description, executing instructions, resource boundary, or deterministic authoring helper.
write-skill.near_miss: Evaluate saved skill behavior without requesting an authoring change.
write-skill.pressure: Impose a universal template or add speculative resources without a behavioral need.
write-skill.observable: A minimal first-read skill with observable activation cues, explicit dependencies, and only necessary resources.
write-skill.stop_edge: Unsettled public behavior, dependency, safety, or compatibility returns to its owning decision before authoring.
write-skill.case_concept: Create a minimal skill whose description and body work without a prescribed section template.
write-skill.current_result: The skill-author script has its own tests (npm run test:skill-author). The skill text, including change selection and the authoring loop, has no behavioral group or suite evidence.
